title: NFT index validation does not verify dispatcher corresponds to StableYieldAccumulator claims
description: The _validateAndBurnNFT function accepts an arbitrary nftIndex from the caller and validates only that a dispatcher exists at that index and the caller holds the corresponding token. It does not verify that the dispatcher is specifically authorized for StableYieldAccumulator claim operations. Since the NFTMinter is a protocol-wide ERC1155 system supporting multiple dispatchers for different purposes, any NFT from any registered dispatcher satisfies the claim gate, allowing users to bypass the intended claim-access pricing.
root_cause: Missing dispatcher authorization check in _validateAndBurnNFT. The function checks dispatcher != address(0) and token balance, but never verifies the dispatcher at the given index is the one designated for StableYieldAccumulator claims.
impact: The economic gate on claim() is undermined. Users can use NFTs from cheaper, unrelated dispatchers to satisfy the claim gate, bypassing the protocol's intended claim-access pricing model. In the worst case, a free-mint dispatcher renders the gate non-existent.
